name: Through Blood and Haven
summary: Both halves of the title are literal. The BLOOD is Ceri and Dessie — married in this arc by Ceri's own hand, under her clan's rite rather than the Family's. The HAVEN is Specter Haven, built on the same Southern Woods land, with Wildwood Hearth raised between the two houses. Six girls are adopted, two of them the Cathedral's leads. The Family stops being one house.
events: Ceri and Dessie are Blood Bonded — Ceri officiates her own marriage, because her clan's rite is not the one Livi would perform
Wildwood Hearth is built, standing between the two houses
Ida and Mikaela arrive already married — adopted as wives
Sir Trashmuffin drags Zephi to Sage's doorstep
The Nereid Rite — transformation by intention
SAGE INHERITS WILDWOOD & THYME AND THE ARC OPENS ON IT — her grandmother passes, Sage moves into the shop permanently. Grief and gratitude together, and the Found Family holds her through it
WILDWOOD HEARTH IS A COMMUNITY PROJECT, inspired by Sage needing somewhere to visit from — 200 to 400 yards from Ghost Haven, near the garden and the trail
Sage's first stay at Wildwood Hearth — testing it out, processing grief in a space built safe on purpose
MEMORIAL SERVICE FOR SAGE'S GRANDMOTHER — flowers from Ivy's garden, tea ceremony by Akane
THE BLOOD-BOUND MARRIAGE: nomadic tribal ceremony, blood oath, and COCK RINGS AND NAVEL PIERCINGS FORGED BY BRYN
SPECTER HAVEN IS BUILT AFTER LILI AND ARIANNA ARE ADOPTED
EDEN AND DIA ESTABLISH A TWICE-YEARLY, THREE-TO-FOUR-DAY VISITATION ROUTINE
Wedding prep for Arc 11's four ceremonies begins — Bryn starts crafting multiple ring sets, Yvaine begins sewing four wedding ensembles
THEMES: loss and legacy · building sanctuary · blood bonds · chosen bonds · permanence and roots
